tasks.fix: Fixed CPU widget drag-and-drop UX in templates/cpu.html: (1) Replaced native glitchy DnD with a placeholder-based drag preview and drag-mode toggle—dragging is now enabled only after clicking the '✋ Drag' button to avoid accidental drags. (2) Replaced ambiguous '⋮⋮' handles with a clear '☰' drag handle, hover highlight, and opacity/cursor feedback. (3) Added a '👁 Manage' button that opens a widget manager modal where each widget can be shown/hidden; hidden state persists to localStorage alongside pinned/saved state. (4) Added per-widget '🙈' hide buttons and persisted hidden/minimized states. (5) Reset now clears order, pinned, hidden, minimized, and drag-mode keys and reloads. Charts remain rendered after reorder because only the widget cards move, not their internal content.

tasks.title: SSD scrapper doesnt seem to download images and attach image_url to listing database
tasks.fix: Fixed SSD image handling: (1) src/scraper/ssd_parser.py now extracts image_url from multiple selectors (#content_sys_div_msg img, img.pic_thumbnail, img.isfoto, #msg_div_msg) with absolute URL normalization. (2) src/scraper/ssd_scraper.py now persists image_url on every update and initializes the ImageDownloader (like GPU/CPU/RAM), calling download_image() after saving a listing and storing the returned local_image_path via ListingRepository.update_local_image_path. (3) src/utils/image_downloader.py now returns the path relative to base_dir (correct ssds/... layout) and uses realistic browser headers to satisfy the SS image CDN. (4) src/database/schema.sql and migrations/add_listing_local_image_path.sql add local_image_path TEXT. Verified end-to-end: SSD listings now save both image_url and local_image_path (e.g. bojpof -> ssds\bojpof_078ab12e.jpg).

tasks.title: filter should also filter out task tickets in future folder
tasks.fix: Added an 'Include future folders' checkbox to the Project Board filter bar (default unchecked). Updated taskMatchesFilters() so tasks with future_folder_id or folder_id are hidden from column task lists when the toggle is off. Existing column text search and dropdown filters continue to work for both regular and future-folder tasks when the toggle is on. Future column folders themselves remain visible regardless of the toggle so they can still be browsed directly.

tasks.title: create a scrapper that will check and download all images for andele listings
tasks.fix: Created src/utils/download_missing_andele_images.py in SS-CRAWLER, mirroring the T077 ss.com downloader pattern.
